references.text: Kibsajim is mentioned as one of the cities in the territory of the tribe of Benjamin, which was later given to the Levites.
Beth-horon is mentioned as a border city in the territory of the tribe of Ephraim, the same city that was given to the sons of Kohath.
Beth-horon is mentioned again in connection with the borders of Ephraim.
A parallel passage in Chronicles lists the same Levitical cities from the territory of Ephraim, including Beth-horon with its pasturelands.
Solomon built Lower Beth-horon, which shows the city's later significance.
Solomon built Upper and Lower Beth-horon as fortified cities.
